proposals.evidence: CDIAL 9188 bahukāra/bahukarī gives Prakrit bōhārī, Punjabi buhārī/bahārī and Sindhi buhārī “broom”. The link uses the historical family containing these feminine broom forms; reduced unrelated broom stems are not assumed to belong.
